export function ValidCopy({ t, locale, localize, error }: { t: (key: string) => string; locale: string; localize: (message: string) => string; error: Error }) {
  const date = new Date();
  return (
    <section aria-label={t("graphPreview")}>
      <h1>{t("heading")}</h1>
      <span>API</span>
      <span>{date.toLocaleString(locale)}</span>
      <span>{localize(error.message)}</span>
    </section>
  );
}
